claims.claim_vi: Proto defines service/messages and code generation creates stubs/server code; the message is serialized, not the stub.
Unary RPC has one request and response; gRPC supports three other streaming shapes.
Native gRPC request/response protocol uses HTTP/2.
Client deadlines bound waiting; client/server outcomes can differ and cancellation does not roll back changes.
claims.section: Deadlines/Timeouts; RPC termination; Cancelling an RPC

claims.claim_vi: Clients should set realistic deadlines rather than assuming a default bounds waiting.

design_notes_vi: Luồng unary dọc tám bước mới; REST/JSON chỉ là cửa vào ví dụ. Phân biệt mã stub với bytes của message; request và response đều có đường về. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Corrects serialization of the stub to serialization of the message.
Omits 5X faster-than-JSON claim because no benchmark workload, environment or evidence is supplied.
